notes.en: [[character:valeriy]] is a buff and shield support who is primarily used to increase the damage of [[element:electro]] or [[element:electro]] [[element:stellar-conduct]] damage. [[character:valeriy]] creates a shield with his [[ability:skill]]. He gains stacks by using his [[ability:skill]], [[ability:burst]], and when teammates deal [[element:electro]] damage. These stacks increase the buff provided by his enhanced [[ability:ca]], which thereby increases the damage of [[element:electro]] or [[element:electro]] [[element:stellar-conduct]] damage based on his [[stat:atk]] and the number of stacks consumed. [[character:valeriy]]'s buff will only work on [[element:stellar-conduct]] damage if he is in the Radiance: [[element:stellar-conduct]] state.
